5. Concluded: no matching message exists

- Did NOT present the decoy as the match
- Correctly identified that no message meets all conditions (specifically, no message has Diego's thumbsup)
- Offered the near-miss (the rollback steps message) as an alternative, clearly stating it doesn't match because it has no reactions

- It mentions the decoy message but explicitly says it doesn't match because it has no reactions

This is clearly `correct_absent`. The solver correctly identified that no message satisfies all the conditions (specifically the Diego thumbsup condition), made no changes, and reported the absence while describing the near misses.
